QUEM SOMOS NÓS

Avolta é líder mundial em experiência de viagens. Com uma filosofia centrada no viajante e uma rede geograficamente diversificada, no varejo de viagem e (A&B) alimentos e bebidas.

A empresa atende às necessidades de até 2,3 bilhões de passageiros a cada ano, com 5.500 pontos de venda em mais de 75 países em 06 continentes.

title: Marketing Manager, Latin America
description:
** ALL APPLICATIONS MUST BE SUBMITTED IN ENGLISH FOR REVIEW**

The Role

Rystad Energy is seeking an enthusiastic, energetic, analytical, and adaptable Marketing Manager in Rio or Houston to join our regional marketing team. The ideal candidate for this role will be tasked with supporting the development and growth of a full-scale Latin America marketing plan, including, but not limited to, account-based marketing for key accounts, lead generation efforts, and local events. You will be part of the Americas Marketing team and work very closely with the global marketing verticals, the local commercial team and other corporate teams, joining meetings and aligning with framework and best practices to understand and align strategies.

Key responsibilities

  • Overall responsible for developing and executing Rystad Energy's regional marketing plans (for Latin America) and campaigns for the designated key sub-markets, and adjusting and optimizing those plans by evaluating success scores
  • Develop and execute and develop the Account-Based Marketing strategy and activities for selected key accounts, as part of the Client Marketing strategy
  • Plan and execute local events of varying sizes to align with commercial objectives
  • Understand our target market and utilize marketing tactics - whitepapers, webinars, webpages, email campaigns, broadcast, partnerships -to fill the marketing bowtie and nurture incoming leads further to sales-qualified leads
  • Partner with the growth marketing team to lead high-intent paid search,conversion rate optimization,leadnurturingand technical landing pages with responsibility for local postinganddevelop andexecute multi-touch campaigns for attribution,nurturingandexpansion
  • Understand the energy market and how different changes can be incorporated into your current marketing activities
  • Identify and develop local thought leaders for enhanced content generation and community-building efforts
  • Take part in regional commercial feedback by running surveys, interviewing Sales and gathering feedback to input into the overall regional marketing strategy
  • Identify and support external events and partnerships associated with sub- region's needs

Skills and attributes for success

  • 3-5 years of relevant work experience (regional marketing, account-based marketing, product marketing, digital marketing, sales enablement, positioning and messaging, audience marketing)
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, advertising, or communications
  • Fluent in Portuguese and/or Spanish (Portuguese preferred) in addition to English
  • Previous experience with the energy sector, consulting industry, or DaaS/SaaS
  • Proven track record of organizing and hosting webinars, events and content-based campaigns
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills (all materials in English, sometimes translated to local languages for the market)
  • Knowledge of CRM systems, marketing automation platforms, webinar-hosting tools, Canva, and basic videography/video editing capabilities are beneficial
  • Strategic thinker with analytical skills
  • Team player comfortable with managing multiple stakeholders with strong opinions
  • Strong multi-taskerwith the ability to remain focused
  • Self-motivated achiever comfortable communicating with all seniority levels
  • Must be willing to collaborate across time zones (EMEA, AMERICAS, APAC)
  • A keen interest, knowledge and understanding of AI tools and how they can be used to enhance work and productivity

Location

This position will be located in Houston or Rio de Janeiro or Sao Paolo and reports to the Head of Americas Marketing.

What we offer

  • A global and quickly expanding international business culture
  • A diverse, dynamic, entrepreneurial, and highly skilled working environment
  • Development opportunities internationally
  • Competitive compensation package and bonus plan
  • 100% employer-paid healthcare premiums for you and your family
  • 401(k) employer match up to 5%
  • Four weeks of vacation

Application process

Please include a cover letter, CV and other relevant documents in a combined PDF file when you upload your application. Αll applications must be sent exclusively via our portal. MacOS users may experience difficulties in uploading documents. Please use a Windows PC in order to apply. Application deadline: May 8, 2025.

About Rystad Energy

Headquartered in Oslo, Norway, and with offices across the globe, Rystad Energy is independent Energy research and business intelligence company providing data, tools, analytics, and consultancy services to clients exposed to the energy industry across the globe.

Rystad Energy has a range of global databases and research products for companies in the Oil & Gas, Oilfield Services, and Renewables sectors, as well as Investors, Investment Banks and Governments. We also provide a range of advisory services for our clients with capabilities across the Energy value chain.

Rystad Energy is a rapidly growing company providing the next generation analytical tools and advice for the industry. Rystad Energy combines a high-performance culture with a deeply collaborative ethos, providing ample opportunities for growth, learning, contribution, and career advancement. Read more at

title: HSS and Signalling Engineer - São Paulo/Rio de Janeiro Based
description:
Overview

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. The company operates a fully regulated telecommunications platform across 40 countries worldwide, including its own global mobile core network, in-house eSIM technology, and a broad portfolio of telecom licenses.

We serve many of the world’s leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast-moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally , enabling customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million , we generate strong cash flows to fund growth and continue investing in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion.

Founded in 2022 by technology entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in 28 additional markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

About the Team

As a Network Engineering member, in the Signalling functional area, you will be responsible for proposing, analyzing and defining the requirements for new and existing services and systems related to the signalling routing area and subscriber data management systems under the responsibility of the functional area. Prepare, design, test and provide new solutions or product changes for the existing portfolio. Define and support the technology evolution roadmap for the systems under the functional area. Participate and support other functional areas in cross-functional projects.

About the Role

  • Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery. Network design. Integration and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments. Responsible for end-to-end delivery
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLDs, LLDs, WOs, etc.) and maintaining it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Perform implementations in live environments. Understanding of end-to-end system testing requirements
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Service & Resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and address design issues for future products or technologies
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers and service providers
  • Elaborate and manage the process for change requests to current partners to meet network needs
  • Control the network elements roadmap, responsible for necessary software/hardware upgrades during the components lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including cross-team processes
  • Document the existing technology portfolio and propose recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives

Requirements

Must-haves

  • Proven experience in implementing live mobile telecom solutions (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), network design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience in the design, test and operation of signalling network functions, including STPs, DEA/DRAs and HLR/HSS
  • Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining signalling interconnects (SIGTRAN and DIAMETER) using SCTP multi-homing
  • Experience with HLR/HSS, subscriber profiles, subscriber repositories and reference interfaces
  • Knowledge of IMS Architecture with understanding of IMS nodes, including Application Servers and its interaction with profile repositories
  • Experience in mobile services charging (online). Knowledge and experience with Ro, Gy, Gx interfaces
  • Knowledge and experience with signalling protocols and routing including M3UA, M2PA, DIAMETER, as well as upper layer protocols such as MAP, CAMEL, Sh, Cx
  • Knowledge of 5G SA networks from a signalling (SCP and SEPP) and AUSF/UDM/UDR perspective
  • Experience with protocol analyser tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architectures and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory; other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice-to-haves

  • +3 years working in telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
  • Previous experience with Nokia, Oracle, HPE products

Benefits

What We Offer?

  • CLT contract — job stability and reliable benefits
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave - 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: Collaborate daily with management and external advisors, exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where ideas are heard and open dialogue is encouraged
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency and impact

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer and we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

About City Explorer

City Explorer is a global livestreaming platform connecting people and cultures through real‑life, immersive content. Our Explorers livestream cities, nature, culture, and daily life worldwide, supported by professional tools, structured training, and hands‑on coaching.

As the platform and Academy continue to grow, maintaining consistent livestream quality is critical. We are now expanding our coaching leadership team.

The Role: Coach Manager (Livestreaming Quality Lead)

We are looking for a Coach Manager who will oversee our team of livestreaming coaches and take primary responsibility for maintaining high standards across the platform.

This role combines leadership, coaching supervision, quality control, and operational oversight. You will ensure livestreams meet both technical and content standards while helping coaches support Explorers effectively.

Livestreaming runs around the clock, so this role requires strong ownership, resilience, and initiative. You should be comfortable maintaining quality standards through team coordination, structured supervision, and proactive monitoring even outside standard working hours when needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate the livestream coaching team
  • Maintain overall livestream quality across the platform
  • Monitor both technical execution and content standards
  • Guide coaches on feedback quality, coaching structure, and consistency
  • Identify quality issues early and implement improvements
  • Support onboarding, training workflows, and coaching processes
  • Ensure Explorers maintain confidence, structure, and audience engagement during streams

Requirements

  • Strong personality with high accountability and ownership mindset
  • Proven experience in livestreaming, video content, media production, or coaching
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills
  • Strong work ethic and ability to operate in a fast‑moving environment
  • Solid understanding of livestream technical setup and content presentation
  • Ability to coordinate teams and maintain standards consistently

Nice to Have

  • Previous team leadership or managerial experience
  • Background in media, broadcasting, or digital content production
  • Experience in training or mentoring creators
  • Familiarity with IRL livestreaming workflows

What We Offer

  • Direct impact on the quality and growth of a global livestreaming platform
  • Leadership role within an expanding international team
  • Clear salary progression based on performance
  • Hands‑on involvement in both platform operations and training
  • Long‑term growth opportunities as City Explorer scales

How to Apply

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

If you believe you are a strong fit and ready to take ownership of livestream quality at scale, please apply with a short introduction outlining your experience, leadership background, and availability.

title: Associate - Procurement (A&M Infra)
description:
Sobre a Alvarez & Marsal

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) é uma consultoria global com mais de 10.000 profissionais empreendedores, orientados para a ação e resultados, em mais de 40 países. Adotamos uma abordagem prática para resolver os problemas de nossos clientes e ajudá-los a atingir seu pleno potencial. Nossa cultura celebra pensadores independentes e realizadores que impactam positivamente nossos clientes e moldam nossa indústria. O ambiente colaborativo e o trabalho envolvente – guiados pelos valores centrais da A&M de Integridade, Qualidade, Objetividade, Diversão, Recompensa Pessoal e Diversidade Inclusiva – são as razões pelas quais nossos colaboradores adoram trabalhar na A&M.

A equipe

A A&M Infra se dedica a todos os aspectos do ciclo de vida de projetos de capital intensivo, incluindo grandes empreendimentos nas áreas de Mineração, Portos, O&G, Aeroportos, Siderurgia, Ferrovias, Papel & Celulose, Rodovias, Energia, Telecom, Saneamento e Real Estate. Nossa atuação abrange desde a estruturação de projetos e processos de M&A relacionados a ativos de infraestrutura até todas as etapas de desenvolvimento e implementação, além da gestão dos ativos.

Como você irá contribuir

  • Consolidar dados para permitir uma análise crítica da situação.
  • Elaborar apresentações e relatórios internos e para clientes.
  • Apresentar dados analisados a gestores e clientes.
  • Participar da execução de projetos, cumprindo prazos e padrões de qualidade.
  • Executar as linhas de serviço de I&CP.
  • Trabalhar em múltiplos projetos e colaborar com colegas e clientes em diversas áreas e setores.
  • Responder rapidamente às demandas do projeto e antecipar ações essenciais para o sucesso das iniciativas.

Qualificações

  • Formação acadêmica em engenharia.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos técnicos adquiridos na formação acadêmica.
  • Boa capacidade analítica e habilidade de estruturar raciocínios.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de projetos é um diferencial.
  • Habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado (opcional).

Sua jornada na A&M

Reconhecemos que nossos colaboradores são a força motriz por trás do nosso sucesso, e é por isso que priorizamos uma experiência que favorece o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal único de cada pessoa. Nosso robusto processo de desenvolvimento de desempenho promove o aprendizado contínuo, recompensa suas contribuições e cultiva uma cultura de meritocracia. Com treinamentos de alta qualidade e oportunidades de aprendizado prático, você pode adquirir novas habilidades e avançar em sua carreira.

Priorizamos o seu bem-estar, oferecendo benefícios e recursos para apoiar sua jornada pessoal. Nossos colaboradores destacam constantemente as oportunidades de crescimento, nossa cultura empreendedora única e a diversão que vivenciamos juntos como os aspectos favoritos de trabalhar na A&M. As possibilidades são infinitas para profissionais de alto desempenho e paixão.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Diversidade Inclusiva significa que abraçamos a diversidade e promovemos a inclusão, incentivando todos a trazerem seu Âu completo para o trabalho a cada dia. Isso permeia a maneira como recrutamos, desenvolvemos os colaboradores, conduzimos os negócios, apoiamos os clientes e fazemos parcerias com fornecedores. É a forma A&M de ser.

Empregador de Oportunidades Iguais

É prática da Alvarez & Marsal fornecer e promover oportunidades iguais em emprego, compensação e outras condições de trabalho, sem discriminação por raça, cor, credo, religião, origem nacional, ascendência, status de cidadania, sexo ou gênero, identidade de gênero ou expressão de gênero (incluindo status de pessoa transgênero), orientação sexual, estado civil, serviço militar e status de veterano, deficiência física ou mental, histórico médico familiar, informações genéticas ou qualquer outra condição médica protegida, afiliação política ou qualquer outra característica protegida por e em conformidade com as leis aplicáveis. Colaboradores e Candidatos podem encontrar as declarações de política da A&M e informações adicionais por região aqui.

Currículos Não Solicitados de Recrutadores de Terceiros

Informamos que, conforme a política da A&M, não aceitamos currículos não solicitados de recrutadores de terceiros, a menos que esses recrutadores sejam contratados para fornecer candidatos para uma vaga específica e em alinhamento com nossos valores de Diversidade Inclusiva. Qualquer agência de emprego, pessoa ou entidade que envie um currículo não solicitado o faz com o entendimento de que a A&M terá o direito de contratar esse candidato a seu critério, sem que haja qualquer taxa devida à agência de emprego, pessoa ou entidade que tenha enviado o currículo.

description:
Manager, Access Management Cluster

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, you will be a key member of the FIFA WOMEN´S WORLD CUP 2027 Access Management team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the Access Management operations for all the official venues across the tournament within Brazil, in line with Access Management policies and procedures.

Through close coordination with other Functional Area (FA) and venue managers, you will ensure that the operations relating to the key movements of persons holding a FIFA access device into and within their official venues meets the requirements and provide efficient, safe, and well‑planned ingress, circulation & egress.

The Access Management Cluster Manager will assist the Access Management Senior Manager by supporting the Access Management Venue Managers in the preparation stages of the tournament with the possibility of then assuming the position of Access Management Venue Manager of the Rio de Janeiro Stadium during the tournament.

You will ensure security personnel and other responsible staff are provided with the necessary information, training and tools to operate access control effectively at each required location.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversight, training and support to the Access Management Venue Managers across all official venues including Stadia, Broadcast Centre, Venue Specific Hotels, and Training Sites.
  • Implementation and operation of Access Management policies and procedures for accredited individuals in line with the accreditation and safety and security concepts for the tournament, including access control point setup and entitlement resolution.
  • Planning and mapping of key client group flows, vertical transportation and ingress points onto venue maps and communication of flows and ingress points to all client groups via the provision of access tours, maps and briefings.
  • Ensuring all client group flows, paths of travel, entrances and exits planned for people with disabilities and/or limited mobility meet FIFA and related local Accessibility standards and requirements.
  • Provision of key wayfinding information as required to FIFA Dressing & Signage to ensure wayfinding on site is correct and as per all client group flows. Ensure that all wayfinding meets FIFA Accessibility standards and requirements.
  • Facilitate additional and exceptional access requirements onsite and assist all client groups with any access related issues.
  • Ensuring all Functional Areas (FAs) at the venues can locate their working areas and know how to reach them, within the constraints of privilege zoning and restrictions.
  • Ensuring all access staff and volunteers are trained and fully understand their roles and function and can perform the duties expected of them.

Profile

Education

title: Billing Analyst I
description:
Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift's sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit.

This position is to work on a hybrid schedule in our office in Rio de Janeiro.

Principle Accountabilities

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un-invoiced, missed, or incorrect amount that is not billed in a timely manner to the client or becomes aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non-funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS (vendor management system) with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and in a timely manner between Airswift's legal entities.
  • Work to the month-end deadlines.
  • Compare invoices from Tempest (payroll and billing system) to invoices generated in Amalto to ensure all relevant information has been saved in SharePoint and maintained in line with auditing requirements.
  • Import invoices to Dynamics 365 (financial ERP system), and balance payroll and billing Tempest to D365, ensuring all billing has been captured.
  • Complete submittal logs in a timely fashion and attend weekly submittal meetings with the Billing Supervisor.
  • Ensure all invoices and backups are filed in a shared drive and maintained.
  • Complete queries in a 48-hour turnaround (outside of main invoicing schedules) and maintain and complete query log.
  • Liaise with payroll to validate any payroll adjustments affected by credit notes and complete credit note logs for auditing purposes.
  • Review new client contracts with the Billing Supervisor to ensure all requirements are captured.
  • Ensure Bullhorn (client management system) data is correct and highlight errors to consultants and service teams accordingly.
  • Meet accuracy targets in line with KPIs.
  • Purchase order and work order analysis.
  • Maintain and deliver 3rd party reconciliations and advise the billing supervisor of details to pay – this is working with credit control to ascertain paid invoices (pay when paid basis).
  • Communicate with various parties of the PO analysis ceilings to ensure timely delivery of either renewed PO value or extended PO.
  • Support function for MIDE region invoicing as and when required.
  • Be fully involved in working with credit control to reduce DSO and improve the liquidity of Airswift for the North American region.
  • Follow company policies and procedures, guidelines, and standards.
  • Ad hoc duties as and when required.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • 1+ years of experience in a finance function (billing experience preferred, but not required).
  • Knowledge of multi-currency transactions.
  • Knowledge of VAT and WHT is beneficial.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to work in a challenging environment with the ability to meet deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Experience in liaising with various internal departments.
  • Focused and dedicated mindset.
  • Good team player with the ability to drive changes and improvements.
  • Knowledge of funding and non-funding.
  • Knowledge of withholding tax (training provided).

What we can offer you!

  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work‑life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires).
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

Working with Java, Spring Boot, React, TypeScript, and AWS, you’ll develop microservices, design APIs, and deliver responsive interfaces with live updates.   • Experience with WebSockets or other real‑time/streaming technologies;

  • Practical experience with Redis or message/event systems;
  • Experience deploying and operating services on AWS or another cloud provider;

  • Hands‑on experience with AI coding tools;
  • Experience integrating REST APIs on the frontend and handling loading and error states;
  • Familiarity with frontend testing frameworks such as Jest;

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience with React Query or similar server‑state libraries;
  • Experience with React Hook Form or other advanced form libraries;
  • Experience with Redis pub/sub or Redis Streams in production;
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform;
  • Familiarity with AWS services such as Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, and S3;
  • Experience in domains with data sensitivity, auditing, or role‑based access requirements.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD‑based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
  • Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

title: Post Doctoral Research Associate -1
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

Howard University’s University Transportation Center seeks a highly qualified Postdoctoral Research Associate specializing in structural health monitoring (SHM) of transportation infrastructure. The associate will lead and support federally funded projects aimed at developing and deploying advanced sensing, data analysis, and system-identity techniques to assess the condition of transportation assets.

SUPERVISORY AUTHORITY: NA

Nature And Scope

Support transportation engineering research at Howard University. The role engages with internal faculty and researchers, as well as external partners.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Support the Center’s mission by managing and executing research activities on transportation infrastructure safety, research implementation, and technology transfer initiatives.
  • Collaborate with internal faculty, researchers, and external partners to plan and carry out research to design, implement, and validate structural health monitoring (SHM) methods.
  • Conduct field deployments; process large-scale time-series data; apply statistical, machine-learning, computer vision, and signal-processing methods to detect damage or degradation.
  • Contribute to proposal writing, technical reports, presentations, and peer-reviewed publications.
  • Facilitate workshops, seminars, and public engagement events related to transportation engineering.
  • Assist in meeting all reporting requirements for sponsored research projects.

Core Competencies

  • Ph.D. in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated expertise in structural health monitoring, system identification, and signal processing.
  • Proficiency with system identification methods, structural dynamics, and programming environments (e.g., MATLAB, Python).
  • Experience with statistical and machine-learning techniques applied to time-series or spatial data.
  • Strong organizational skills: ability to manage multiple tasks, adhere to deadlines, and collaborate across disciplines.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, evidenced by peer-reviewed publications or conference presentations.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse research team.

Minimum Requirements

Ph.D. in a scientific and/or research discipline related to the research projects.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$60,000-$70,000

description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

A successful alumni relations program depends on a robust strategy to build lasting relationships with alumni and ensure their continued engagement and support. The Assistant Director, Alumni Programs, focuses on developing and implementing centralized engagement initiatives and programs to support the alumni community at Howard University. This role is a key driver in fostering a lifelong connection between the University and its alumni population through educational, professional development, and networking opportunities.

Supervisory Authority

This position will have supervisory authority over the Manager for Career and Professional Development Manager and the Manager for Reunion Programs. The Assistant Director provides leadership, direction, coaching, performance management, and professional development for these positions; establishes annual goals and priorities; and ensures alignment across program portfolios.

Nature And Scope

Reporting to the Director of Alumni Relations, this position oversees strategies and long-term projects that aim to cultivate a strong, supportive, and engaged alumni network. The Assistant Director will be a key driver in the growth of centralized alumni engagement through programs, outreach, and volunteer development. This role works closely with the Director of Alumni Relations to develop sustainable alumni programs and execute priorities and will serve as a liaison for internal and external stakeholders, representing the Alumni Relations team through various forms of communication. The position requires collaboration with various campus partners, including the career services and development teams, to ensure alignment of efforts and to promote philanthropic support from alumni. This role is also responsible for overseeing career development opportunities and reunions.

Principal Accountabilities

  • The Assistant Director, Alumni Programs, is responsible for the day-to-day operation of long-term alumni programs, focusing on centralized, non-geographical initiatives.
  • This includes planning, developing, and executing programs that provide career readiness and professional development for alumni.
  • The role will manage platforms and projects that facilitate alumni mentorship and networking.
  • The position is accountable for overseeing the planning and execution of all alumni reunions and reunion staff roles.
  • Additionally, the position works alongside the campus partners like the Office of the Secretary, Center for Career and Professional Success, and the Ralphe Bunche Center.
  • A key responsibility includes developing and disseminating engaging content through various channels, including newsletters, social media, and online communities, to keep alumni informed and connected.
  • The Assistant Director will also track and analyze alumni engagement metrics and use this data to inform future strategies and improve programs.
  • The role also involves collaborating with leadership to identify and recognize alumni contributions through programs and events.
  • This position will support efforts to maintain an up-to-date alumni database and provide reports to university stakeholders as requested.

Core Competencies

  • Proven experience in planning and executing large-scale events and multi-channel engagement strategies.
  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to build and maintain relationships with diverse constituencies.
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Proficiency in relevant technologies, including alumni databases (e.g., Raiser’s Edge), event management tools, PeopleGrove, and social media.
  • Ability to work comfortably and effectively both independently and in group scenarios.
  • A belief in and ability to articulate the university's mission and the importance of alumni engagement.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field such as business, marketing, or communications. Master’s degree preferred.
  • Three (3) to five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in alumni relations, event management, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Experience working with various software programs for engagement, including marketing platforms, event platforms, or CRM systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed for events or meetings

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary range: $75,000 - $85,000

  • 4+ years of backend development experience with Java (preferably Java 11+)
  • Hands‑on experience with Spring Boot and OpenAPI for building REST APIs
  • Experience with WebSockets or other real‑time/streaming technologies
  • Solid understanding of relational databases such as MySQL including schema design, indexing, and query optimization
  • Experience with database migration tools such as Flyway or Liquibase
  • Practical experience with Redis or message/event systems
  • Experience deploying and operating services on AWS or another cloud provider
  • Ability to write automated backend tests (unit and integration)

  • Hands‑on experience with AI coding tools
  • Professional experience with React and TypeScript or strong JavaScript
  • Experience integrating REST APIs on the frontend and handling loading and error states
  • Familiarity with frontend testing frameworks such as Jest

title: Tech Lead Analyst, Software Engineering and Data Science (Open to Internal and External applicants)
description:
Overview

Tiered Approach In Line With The Commitment To Safeguard Capacity And Support Personnel Already In The Organization, a Majority Of UNDP UNCDF/UNV Vacancies Are Advertised Using a Tiered Application Process Whereby

  • Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
  • Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
  • Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
  • Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Job Description

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

UNDP provides integrated programmatic, policy and financing solutions to realize the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). In this context, UNDP has created a Global Policy Network (GPN), a network of field-based and global technical expertise across a wide range of knowledge domains and in support of the signature solutions and organizational capabilities envisioned in the Strategic Plan. The Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) and the Crisis Bureau (CB) are the two anchor Bureaux of the GPN.

In this context, the newly established Governance, Rule of Law, and Peacebuilding (GRP) Hub, a joint endeavor with the Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS), provides leadership and advisory services to enhance UNDP’s impact on governance and peacebuilding, ensuring the integration of democratic governance and human rights into crisis response and recovery.

Through Local Action, the GRP Hub seeks to contribute to peace and development, achieving a visible impact on communities and improving lives by delivering integrated solutions that harness global expertise and partnerships. The Local Action Unit works closely with local and regional governments as key development players, highlighting their role as public service implementers, as drivers of innovation and the closest institution to people.

Local and regional governments are already responsible for over 65% of the SDG targets, most of them linked to basic service provision from water, sanitation, mobility, climate action, health or education. Cities and territories are playing a big part in the implementation of SDGs, becoming a tool for strategic planning and budgeting in the mid to long term. Since 2015, local governments and their associations have been active in promoting the SDGs through advocacy, working with their local population and partners in transposing the spirit of Agenda 2030 in cities and territories. Local Governments have also started to use SDGs as a framework to deliver better public services linked to SDG targets and indicators. As part of the SDG Local Action project, UNDP is one of the implementing partners of the Mayors Challenge, a global initiative to reimagine essential services that cities deliver to residents.

Duties And Responsibilities

Under the overall supervision of the Project Manager and in close coordination with IplanRio, relevant municipal technical teams, and UNDP, the Tech Lead Analyst, Software Engineering and Data Science will perform the following functions:

  • Lead data engineering and integration
  • Lead the modeling, integration, and transformation of data from multiple municipal secretariats into the Integrated Municipal Registry (RMI)
  • Oversee the development and maintenance of reproducible, scalable, and well-documented data pipelines
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, traceability, and governance across project data assets
  • Guide technical decisions related to data architecture and interoperability
  • Lead analytical and machine learning development
  • Lead the development of analytical and machine learning models to identify patterns, risks, and opportunities relevant to public service delivery
  • Oversee exploratory data analysis and validation processes to generate actionable insights
  • Ensure appropriate model testing, monitoring, and refinement over time
  • Apply and promote the use of model interpretability techniques, where relevant
  • Support product development and decision-making
  • Translate analytical results into practical recommendations and data products for public policy use
  • Work closely with technical teams and sectoral teams to align solutions with operational and policy needs
  • Contribute to the design of proactive communication and service delivery mechanisms informed by data
  • Ensure technical standards, sustainability and knowledge management
  • Establish and promote best practices for versioning, documentation, reproducibility, and code quality
  • Contribute to the definition of technical standards, architecture, and implementation approaches for the project
  • Support the long-term sustainability, maintainability, and scalability of the solution
  • Provide technical guidance to other team members and facilitate collaboration across disciplines

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the project.

Institutional Arrangements

The Tech Lead Analyst will act in close coordination with the Project manager, allocated at IplanRio, municipal technical teams from the City Hall, including the relevant teams from Health, Education, and Social Assistance, and UNDP, contributing to the technical implementation of the project.

The Analyst will report to the Advisor, cities and local governments based in UNDP HQ in New York, USA.

Competencies

Core Competencies

  • Achieve Results: LEVEL 2: Scale up solutions and simplifies processes, balances speed and accuracy in doing work.
  • Think Innovatively: LEVEL 2: Offer new ideas/open to new approaches, demonstrate systemic/integrated thinking.
  • Learn Continuously: LEVEL 2: Go outside comfort zone, learn from others and support their learning.
  • Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 2: Adapt processes/approaches to new situations, involve others in change process.
  • Act with Determination: LEVEL 2: Able to persevere and deal with multiple sources of pressure simultaneously.
  • Engage and Partner: LEVEL 2: Is facilitator/integrator, bring people together, build and/or/maintain coalitions/partnership.
  • Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 2: Facilitate conversations to bridge differences, considers in decision making.

Functional/Technical competencies

  • Business Management: Communication – Ability to communicate in a clear, concise and unambiguous manner both through written and verbal communication; to tailor messages and choose communication methods depending on the audience.
  • Business Management: Working with Evidence and Data – Ability to inspect, cleanse, transform and model data with the goal of discovering useful information, informing conclusions and supporting decision-making.
  • Business Direction & Strategy: System Thinking – Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system.
  • Digital: Data engineering – Ability in programming languages such as SQL, Python, and R, be adept at finding warehousing solutions, and using ETL tools, and understanding basic machine learning and algorithms.
  • Digital: Data governance – Knowledge of data science, skills to develop data management tools, organize and maintain databases and operate data visualization technologies.
  • Information Management & Technology: Data Management & Analytics – Knowledge in data management, data sciences, ability to structure data, develop dashboard and visualization. Design data warehouses, data lakes or data platforms concepts. Familiarity with Machine learning, natural language processing or generation and the use of artificial intelligence to support predictive analytics. CDMP or TOGAF9 or equivalent certification desirable.

Education

Required Skills and Experience

  • Advanced university degree (master’s degree or equivalent) in Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Information Systems, or a related field is required.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a Ekotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

description:
Descrição da vaga

A área de engenharia de dados é responsável por garantir que a organização tenha acesso a dados confiáveis e organizados, possibilitando a criação de insights e a tomada de decisões estratégicas e operacionais. Ser um agente de transformação, construindo uma plataforma escalável e resiliente, democratizar o acesso aos dados e impulsionar uma cultura orientada por dados. Missão da vaga: Projetar, construir e manter pipelines robustos de dados, garantindo que as informações fluam de maneira eficiente e segura. Garantir a disponibilidade, qualidade e governança dos dados. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders e a equipe visando promover melhores práticas na manipulação, análise de grandes volumes de dados e otimização de processos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de armazenamento, incluindo data lakes e data warehouses, em ambientes em nuvem;
  • Garantir a integridade, qualidade e governança dos dados, aplicando boas práticas de gerenciamento e segurança e FINOPS;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócio e oferecer soluções orientadas por dados;
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho de pipelines, bases de dados e soluções de integração;
  • Liderar iniciativas de modernização de arquitetura de dados, utilizando tecnologias e frameworks modernos;
  • Atuar como referência técnica e mentorar engenheiros de dados juniores e plenos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência comprovada com plataformas de data visualização (tableau, power bi e/ou looker);
  • Histórico de liderança ou participação ativa em projetos complexos de integração e migração para nuvem;

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Cloud Computing;
  • Experiência em GCP e seus serviços, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Apache Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Function, KMS, Secret Manager;
  • DataStream, Vertex AI e GitHub;
  • Experiência em Azure e seus serviços, como Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics e Azure Data Lake Storage;
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimento em modelagem de dados, bancos de dados relacionais (ex.: Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (ex.: MongoDB, Cassandra);
  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em Python e PySpark (usado para scripts e automação) e SQL (para manipulação e consulta de dados);
  • ETL/ELT: Experiência na construção de pipelines de ETL/ELT para ingestão e transformação de dados;
  • Data Lakes: Conhecimento de arquiteturas de Data Lake, armazenamento e otimização de dados (ex.: Delta Lake);
  • DevOps: Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD e práticas de DataOps para automação de deploys e monitoramento de fluxos de dados;
  • Segurança e Governança: Entendimento de práticas de segurança em nuvem, criptografia de dados e implementação de políticas de governança;
  • Orquestração de Dados: Uso de ferramentas como Azure Data Factory e/ou Synapse e/ou Airflow/composer para integração e movimentação de dados;
  • Desempenho e Otimização: Experiência em técnicas para melhorar a performance de pipelines de dados e consultas em ambientes distribuídos e não distribuídos;
  • APIs: Conhecimento em extração de dados via APIs RESTful.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações de engenharia de dados nas plataformas GCP e/ou Azure (Professional DataEngineer, Azure Data Engineer Associate).

title: Especialista Logística | Rio de Janeiro
description:
A Eneva no Rio de Janeiro quer você no time! #VemSerEneva

Se você quer atuar como Especialista em Logística - Comércio Exterior e Logística Nacional, temos um novo desafio para você!

Sobre a Eneva

A Eneva é a maior operadora privada de gás natural do Brasil, atuando de forma integrada da produção à geração de energia e avançando de maneira consistente na comercialização de gás natural. Em 2026, a companhia atravessa um ciclo de crescimento impulsionado por novos projetos estruturantes, operações de O&M e iniciativas de expansão (CAPEX), o que exige excelência em logística, comércio exterior, compliance regulatório e eficiência operacional em operações de alta complexidade.

Sobre a posição

Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Logística para atuar como referência técnica e estratégica da companhia, garantindo conformidade legal, eficiência operacional e otimização de custos nas operações de importação, exportação e transporte nacional. A posição terá forte atuação em projetos de grande porte, operações O&M e cargas especiais, assegurando integração com áreas internas e parceiros estratégicos.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar como referência técnica em comércio exterior e logística nacional, assegurando a conformidade das operações de importação, exportação e transporte doméstico com a legislação aduaneira, tributária, regulatória e normas aplicáveis;
  • Liderar tecnicamente a gestão end-to-end de operações de importação, exportação e logística nacional em projetos estratégicos e de grande porte, desde o planejamento até a entrega final;
  • Avaliar, interpretar e aplicar legislações aduaneiras brasileiras, tratados internacionais e normas de órgãos anuentes (Receita Federal, Anvisa, MAPA, Ibama, entre outros), orientando áreas internas quanto a riscos, oportunidades fiscais e compliance;
  • Desenvolver e conduzir estratégias logísticas e aduaneiras para projetos de engenharia, expansão, CAPEX e O&M, incluindo cargas especiais, superdimensionadas e sensíveis;
  • Analisar e validar classificações fiscais (NCM), descrições técnicas, valores aduaneiros e enquadramentos tributários, propondo melhorias para mitigação de riscos fiscais;
  • Planejar, estruturar e acompanhar a aplicação de regimes aduaneiros especiais (Ex-tarifário, Admissão Temporária, Entreposto Aduaneiro, Repetro e similares);
  • Atuar estrategicamente na gestão de contratos logísticos e aduaneiros, contribuindo para definição de escopos, SLAs, KPIs e estratégias de sourcing;
  • Conduzir análises avançadas de custos logísticos e de importação, elaborando estudos de viabilidade econômica e cenários comparativos;
  • Gerenciar indicadores estratégicos de performance logística e aduaneira, liderando planos de ação e iniciativas de melhoria contínua;
  • Atuar como interface técnica com despachantes aduaneiros, autoridades, operadores logísticos e fornecedores estratégicos;
  • Antecipar riscos operacionais, financeiros e regulatórios, propondo soluções preventivas relacionadas a prazos, demurrage, armazenagem e licenças;
  • Participar de projetos corporativos multidisciplinares desde a fase de concepção, representando a área de Comércio Exterior e Logística Nacional;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente analistas e membros da equipe, promovendo desenvolvimento técnico, padronização de práticas e disseminação de conhecimento;
  • Contribuir para a evolução de políticas, procedimentos e governança da área;
  • Conduzir reuniões executivas com prestadores de serviços estratégicos, apresentando indicadores, análises e propostas de melhoria;
  • Avaliar e validar faturas complexas e custos extraordinários de operações logísticas e de comércio exterior;
  • Atuar em interface com as áreas Fiscal e Financeira, garantindo conformidade documental e fiscal;
  • Apoiar processos de BID/RFP/RFQ junto à área de Suprimentos;
  • Garantir a correta utilização e evolução dos sistemas de gestão de comércio exterior (SAP, ERP, OSGT ou similares);
  • Registrar e reportar indicadores de savings, cost avoidance e eficiência operacional;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas internas de Compliance, Código de Conduta, Políticas e diretrizes de SSMA.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação

  • Ensino superior completo em Comércio Exterior, Relações Internacionais, Logística, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Comércio Exterior, Logística, Direito Aduaneiro ou áreas afins (desejável).

Experiência e conhecimentos técnicos

  • Legislação aduaneira e tributária aplicada ao comércio exterior;
  • Regimes aduaneiros especiais;
  • Operações de importação, exportação e logística nacional multimodal;
  • Atuação com cargas especiais e projetos de grande porte;
  • Sistemas de gestão (ERP, SAP e sistemas de comércio exterior);
  • Análise de custos logísticos, KPIs e SLAs;
  • Experiência sólida em comércio exterior e logística nacional, preferencialmente em projetos industriais, energia, óleo e gás ou ambientes de alta complexidade logística.

Competências comportamentais

  • Visão estratégica e sistêmica;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de tomada de decisão;
  • Liderança técnica e capacidade de influência;
  • Comunicação clara e relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Organização, planejamento e gestão de prioridades;

title: Offshore Logistics Coordinator
description:
Overview

Airswift is looking for an Offshore Logistics Coordinator (12 months) to work in a contractor position in Rio de Janeiro for an oil and gas company.

Responsibilities

  • Maintains daily contact with the Well Site Leader (WSL) to define personnel and equipment schedules for time planning.
  • Updates the equivalent logistics system with information on the movement of personnel, equipment, solid bulk, and fluids.
  • Updates the operational status of the logistics system with information on vessel movement, obtains approval from the WSL, and sends it to the daily distribution list.
  • Updates the logistics system with information on vessel operations during the night, using feedback from the night shift deck crew.
  • Updates unloading and return documentation and distributes it to the day shift deck crew.
  • Sends a daily plan to the vessel for both shifts. If there is a need to transport Dangerous Goods (DG) on the vessel's return, prepares the DG documentation and transfers it to the vessel.
  • Completes the daily cost spreadsheet and sends it to the Drilling Engineer.
  • Completes all documentation prior to the completion of vessel operations (Safety Data Sheet, return manifest, and waste transfer notes).
  • Obtains the mud analysis from the Mud Engineer and sends it, along with the documentation, to the vessel.
  • Monitors weather conditions for the vessel's next departure to verify that there are suitable weather conditions for operating the ship.
  • Completes deck planning to verify sufficient space on the platform to receive the cargo.
  • Sends loading instructions to the Supply Base team to verify that priority cargo is accessible (without selective collection). When there is transshipment from the platform, verifies available space.
  • Determines the specific loading order for the platform to collect the casing pipes in the correct sequence.
  • Maintains contact with the Drilling Engineer for the deck layout in casing loading (slick and centered) to verify the correct collection sequence on the platform.
  • Maintains contact with the Platform Stability section for any Variable Deck Loading (VDL) issues, which determines what can be collected on the platform.
  • Maintains contact with the Mud Engineer for all bulk loadings, considering pit space, which may be limited on the platform.
  • Monitors the availability of empty buckets for ship and bucket operations, as this impacts VDL; it calculates the number of full containers for VDL (Very Daily Load) and replaces full containers with empty ones to maintain availability on the platform.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in offshore logistics, specifically in offshore oil and gas operations.
  • English advanced
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Kabal (Wellit).
  • In-depth knowledge of deepwater drilling and completion operations, associated equipment, common suppliers, platform management on a mobile offshore drilling unit, and logistics involved in performing well work.

title: Operations Analyst (Backoffice)
description:
Note To Applicants

  • Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
  • Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
  • Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority.
  • Note: If you're hired for this role, you may be asked to update your LinkedIn profile.

About The Company

Our client is a global technology and digital asset liquidity provider headquartered in Cheyenne, Wyoming. They deliver liquidity expertise, settlement rails, and advanced technology solutions that enable counterparties to participate in the digital asset market in a fully regulated and compliant manner. This role sits at the core of their operational engine, supporting daily trading activities and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial and transactional data.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and disciplined Operations Analyst (Backoffice) to support daily trading operations, data analysis, and reconciliation processes. This person will analyze trading data and liquidity trends, execute and reconcile transactions, manage wallet balances, and ensure the accurate daily close of operational activities. The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, and passionate about the digital asset industry.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct data analysis on trading activity, trends, and liquidity curves.
  • Receive and manage client RFQs, confirming trade details such as size, instrument, and settlement currency.
  • Source pricing from internal liquidity, venues, and liquidity providers to construct accurate quotes.
  • Communicate quotes to clients and track the full quote lifecycle for audit purposes.
  • Execute hedging and offsetting trades to manage risk exposure.
  • Book trades into back-office systems, ensuring accuracy across all fields.
  • Review and approve trade bookings under maker-checker controls.
  • Reconcile daily trading activity, balances, and wallet transactions.
  • Manage wallet balances and ensure accuracy of transaction histories.
  • Process withdrawals in line with internal procedures and regulatory requirements.
  • Perform balance checks to maintain account integrity.
  • Generate and analyze reports on trading activity and operational metrics.
  • Communicate key updates, issues, and transactions to senior management.
  • Collaborate with compliance teams to address and resolve any compliance-related matters.
  • Support daily operational close processes and contribute to financial reporting inputs.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Data Science, or Engineering (graduating seniors welcome).
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to review and compare data with precision.
  • Excellent interpersonal communication skills for effective internal collaboration.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets or Excel, including complex data manipulation.
  • Familiarity with digital assets, cryptocurrency, and related technologies (preferred but not required).
  • Highly disciplined, organized, and methodical approach to tasks and workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in operations, backoffice, reconciliation, or trading environments.
  • Familiarity with financial platforms or digital asset systems.
  • Experience in fintech or digital asset industries.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary: $2,000–$2,500/month, based on experience and qualifications.
  • Professional development: access to training, workshops, and skill-building opportunities.
  • Remote work options: flexibility to work from home or other locations.
  • Dynamic work environment: innovative, collaborative, and fast-paced culture.
  • Growth opportunities: clear pathways for career advancement and leadership.
  • Exciting industry: be part of a cutting-edge, rapidly evolving digital asset ecosystem.

Ready to Apply?

If you are a motivated self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about trading operations and the digital asset market, we encourage you to apply!

Descrição da vaga

Desafios estratégicos

O mercado de mídia e entretenimento vive numa constante transformação, com variadas formas, comportamentos, plataformas e monetização do consumo de conteúdo. Múltiplas empresas de diferentes segmentos competem pela atenção e pelo bolso do consumidor e dos anunciantes. Essa constante transformação vem muito da própria evolução da tecnologia no mundo.

Nesse cenário, a Globo vem buscando diferentes segmentos de audiência, novos produtos, novas estratégias de distribuição, novas formas de operar e novos modelos de negócio.

Para suportar tanta transformação, precisamos entender os movimentos da indústria, o mercado cliente, a nossa estratégia de negócio, as tendências de tecnologia, nossas alavancas e nossos gaps.

Projetar novas capacidades de tecnologia, transformar algumas e, buscar inovação e parcerias, se faz absolutamente necessário.

Atuação de Arquitetura

A Arquitetura de Tecnologia da Globo, busca profissionais que possam trabalhar na interseção entre estratégia de negócio, tecnologia e a execução.

A área tem a missão de desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diversos domínios de negócio e foundations de tecnologia da empresa.

Faz isso com uma abordagem focada nos principais desafios transformacionais da empresa, nos níveis estratégico e tático e de maneira muito colaborativa com outras áreas de tecnologia e do negócio.

A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA.

Traga sua experiência em benchmarks da indústria, mapas de capacidades, arquiteturas de referência, análises de gaps e buy or build e, construção de visões de futuro e roadmaps de tecnologia.

O que a área te oferece

  • Você vai ter um conhecimento amplo da empresa e da indústria de mídia
  • Vai desenvolver um olhar transversal e estratégico entre as capacidades de negócio e tecnológicas de toda a empresa

Posição de Arquitetura de Dados & IA

Esta posição irá ajudar a evoluir a arquitetura fundacional de dados & IA da Globo, que habilita os workloads de analytics, machine learning, generative AI e agentic AI.

Modelo de trabalho

Híbrido (RJ ou SP)

Os resultados imediatos do trabalho desta posição são decisões que vão influenciar a esteira de execução. Portanto, diferentemente de uma área de delivery de software ou operação, as mudanças são sentidas no médio e longo prazo.

title: Manager, Access Management Cluster
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC2027) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

The Position

Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, you will be a key member of the FIFA WOMEN’S WORLD CUP 2027 Access Management team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the Access Management operations for all the official venues across the tournament within Brasil, in line with Access Management policies and procedures. Through close coordination with other Functional Area (FA) and venue managers, you will ensure that the operations relating to the key movements of persons holding a FIFA access device into and within their official venues meets the requirements and provide efficient, safe, and well-planned ingress, circulation & egress. The Access Management Cluster Manager will assist the Access Management Senior Manager by supporting the Access Management Venue Managers in the preparation stages of the tournament with the possibility of then assuming the position of Access Management Venue Manager of the Rio de Janeiro Stadium during the tournament. You will ensure security personnel and other responsible staff are provided with the necessary information, training and tools to operate access control effectively at each required location.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversight, training and support to the Access Management Venue Managers across all official venues including Stadia, Broadcast Centre, Venue Specific Hotels, and Training Sites.
  • Implementation and operation of Access Management policies and procedures for accredited individuals in line with the accreditation and safety and security concepts for the tournament, including access control point setup and entitlement resolution.
  • Planning and mapping of key client group flows, vertical transportation and ingress points onto venue maps and communication of flows and ingress points to all client groups via the provision of access tours, maps and briefings.
  • Ensuring all client group flows, paths of travel, entrances and exits planned for people with disabilities and/or limited mobility meet FIFA and related local Accessibility standards and requirements.
  • Provision of key wayfinding information as required to FIFA Dressing & Signage to ensure wayfinding on site is correct and as per all client group flows. Ensure that all wayfinding meets FIFA Accessibility standards and requirements.
  • Facilitate additional and exceptional access requirements onsite and assist all client groups with any access related issues.
  • Ensuring all Functional Areas (FAs) at the venues can locate their working areas and know how to reach them, within the constraints of privilege zoning and restrictions.
  • Ensuring all access staff and volunteers are trained and fully understand their roles and function and can perform the duties expected of them.

Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar.
  • If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply.
  • Football access management knowledge.
  • FIFA access management knowledge is a plus.
  • Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills.
  • Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
  • Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues.
  • Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people.

Experience

  • Minimum experience of 2 years in the sport event industry, preferably within access management, accreditation, safety and security or venue management. Experience within FIFA is an advantage.
  • Operation and setup of complex access control systems within ticketing and/or accreditation.
  • Wayfinding and route planning in a stadium environment.
  • Single-sport, multi-venue event experience.
  • Management and leadership of a team in high pressure tournament operations.
  • Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure.

Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, AI Agents
description:
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to contribute to our vision and development of Agentic AI tooling and platforms through technical leadership and proactive thinking. Our product is an orchestration platform that enables developers to spin up isolated, AI-powered development sessions that autonomously work on tasks - from Jira tickets to GitHub issues. The team operates without a dedicated product manager; you will be expected to identify problems worth solving, define requirements, and own features from problem statement to production deployment.

Our technical stack spans Rust for CLI tools and API server, React 19 with TypeScript for our frontend, and Kubernetes with Helm on Google Cloud for infrastructure. You will work across this entire stack, leveraging the agentic tooling we build ourselves to contribute effectively beyond your primary domain. Your specialization in backend development - API design, async web frameworks, authentication, databases, and service architecture - will make you the team’s anchor for the API server and backend systems, but you will regularly touch frontend code and infrastructure as the work demands.

The team operates in a startup fashion with a heavy focus on experimentation and prototyping solutions first and evaluating what works in practice rather than heavy upfront requirements given how quickly the agentic space moves.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Make decisions based on multiple quality dimensions like user impact, failure tolerance, code maintenance, implementation time, security breaches, and performance.
  • Implement quality gates and improve agentic-driven processes and workflows.
  • Collaborate on novel ideas to improve the team processes.
